findings: 🟠 [attributes-symlink-raw-bytes] MUST-FIX The `.gitattributes` symlink repair decodes its blob with `toString('utf8')`; a valid Git/POSIX symlink target containing non-UTF-8 bytes is rewritten and subsequently fails the required object-ID integrity check, preventing packet creation for an otherwise supported tree. Preserve the target bytes by passing `blob` directly to `fs.symlinkSync`.
